credentials: Parent transport only; never persist credentials.

limits.third_call: Only diagnose a first-pair role disagreement; never vote into acceptance; separate explicit append-only manifest required.

transport_rules: Preserve every attempt and exact raw response.
Send byte-identical canonical request content for each pair.
No source, oracle, fixture, threshold, or existing candidate edits.
Do not replace any prior history or raw artifact.
Evaluate each candidate on all 14 cases.
A candidate is accepted semantically only with exact roles, exact threshold-0.0 verdicts, stable repeats, and zero regressions. Confidence reference is diagnostic.
Use correlation IDs as local handles, without adding request body fields.
